user_story: As a user, I want to view a product catalogue with sorting options so that I can easily find products based on my preferences. Acceptance criteria: 1. The product catalogue should display a list of items with their titles, and each item should have an 'Add to cart' button. 2. The user should be able to sort the products using the dropdown with the selector [data-test='product-sort-container']. 3. The sorting options should include 'Name (A to Z)', 'Name (Z to A)', 'Price (low to high)', and 'Price (high to low).'
cypress_script: describe('Product Catalogue with Sorting', () => { it('should display products and allow sorting', () => { cy.visit('https://www.saucedemo.com'); cy.get('[data-test="username"]').type('standard_user'); cy.get('[data-test="password"]').type('secret_sauce'); cy.get('[data-test="login-button"]').click(); cy.visit('https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html'); cy.get('[data-test="product-sort-container"]').select('az'); cy.get('[data-test="item-0-title-link"]').should('have.text', 'Sauce Labs Backpack'); cy.get('[data-test="item-1-title-link"]').should('have.text', 'Sauce Labs Bike Light'); cy.get('[data-test="item-2-title-link"]').should('have.text', 'Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt'); }); it('should not display products when logged out', () => { cy.visit('https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html'); cy.url().should('eq', 'https://www.saucedemo.com/'); }); });
playwright_script: import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'; test('Product Catalogue with Sorting', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('https://www.saucedemo.com'); await page.fill('[data-test="username"]', 'standard_user'); await page.fill('[data-test="password"]', 'secret_sauce'); await page.click('[data-test="login-button"]'); await page.goto('https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html'); await page.selectOption('[data-test="product-sort-container"]', 'az'); const firstProduct = await page.locator('[data-test="item-0-title-link"]').textContent(); expect(firstProduct).toBe('Sauce Labs Backpack'); const secondProduct = await page.locator('[data-test="item-1-title-link"]').textContent(); expect(secondProduct).toBe('Sauce Labs Bike Light'); const thirdProduct = await page.locator('[data-test="item-2-title-link"]').textContent(); expect(thirdProduct).toBe('Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt'); }); test('should not display products when logged out', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html'); expect(page.url()).toBe('https://www.saucedemo.com/'); }); });
